title: England goes to war with France again, with its vassals and with Castile beside it; Bohemia stands with France. Castile makes a separate peace on 1 March 1428

data.attackers: England, Burgundy, Brittany, Normandy, Aquitaine, Flanders, Ireland, Wales and others, with Castile
data.defenders: France and its appanages, Bohemia and the Bohemian vassals, Dauphiné

title: Santiago, the largest of the Cape Verde islands, becomes a settlement of the crown: 1,700 settlers, Portuguese in speech and Muslim in faith
Ponta Delgada on São Miguel becomes a settlement of the crown, the fourth in the Azores: 1,200 Andalusī settlers
